main_text.p: סקל סקול Citatur ab Elia ex Genef. 42.4. pro Hebraeo אסון Mors, Exitium, ex Targ.Hierosol. Sed in noftris exemplaribus ibi non legitur. Habetur סקול Levit. 10. 19. in Jonathan. ubi videtur significare Offendiculum.

סקף Ithpah. אסתקף, vel ex Ithpehal אסתקף Ch. Caufam, occafionem, anfam praebere, dare, captare vel quaerere: Item Murmurare: Irruere, Dejicere se in aliquem ex quaesita occasione: Respondet in Thren. nonnunquam Hebr. עולל pro Afficere, Conficere.
תוסקפא Chald. Occafio, Cauffa. Ex plur. legendum, תוסקפתא, pro תוסקפתא, Jobi 37.11.
סקופתא, סקופא, סקופא Ch. Poftis, Limen, Trabs. Plur. סקופתא, סקופן.

סקר Ch. Intueri, contueri, confpicari, confpicere, afpicere: Item ducere, regere, gubernare; Hinc in Targ. Jon. היכמא דמסקר גבר ית בריה יי אלקך מסקריתכון Sicut ducit, gubernat vir filium fuum: sic Dominus Deus tuus ducit vos, Deut.8.5.
סיקוריא, סיקורא C. Securis, Deut.19.5. in T. Jon. & Hier.
סר סרי, סרה Ch. & Syr. Foetere. Aphel אסרי Foetere facere, Foetidum reddere.
סריותא Ch. Idem. Num.11.20. in Jon.
סירא Ch. Lorica, Hebr. שריה ס & ש inter se commutatis, Exod.28.32. in Targ.Hierof.

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic and Syriac words are printed in the original as shown; several forms are set in the scan with diacritics that are partly illegible and have been transcribed as best read. Large letter forms (סקל, סקף, סקר, סר) are the woodcut-style initials of the entries.
